    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies RPC argument handling and deprecation behavior in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp for createrawtransaction and createpsbt.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Follows standard RPC deprecation discipline to phase out redundant 'replaceable' arguments across transaction-creation RPCs. Since full-RBF became default in v28, opt-in sequence signaling is largely obsolete, making argument deprecation a worthwhile interface cleanup."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds minor helper definitions in src/util/rbf.h solely in support of the RPC argument deprecation logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental edits to utility headers that merely serve RPC and wallet behavior do not make a PR part of utils."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Wallet label and modifies spend and fee-bumping wallet RPCs in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deprecates the redundant 'replaceable' option across wallet transaction creation and fee-bumping RPCs (fundrawtransaction, send, bumpfee, etc.). This cleans up confusing and redundant configuration options and unblocks total removal of opt-in RBF signaling logic (#32661)."
